what: The FM-1 overload guard before and after issue #458, on the test rig. Patches built from the cards (parseCard, applyPreset, encodePatch): Oracle V Poly-Mod Bell on five voices (the card before PR #457), Io 4 Ensemble Pad, Ensemble Pad without its vibrato (issue #461), Io 4 Init.
how: probes: a scratch script uploads the patch, holds N notes over USB MIDI for 6 s and reads DIAG pages 119 and 127 about every 0.6 s. Per row: halves rendered, halves over 85 %, late halves (the hardware played the half before its render ended), the longest run of halves over 85 %, the longest gap between audio interrupts (us; 5,802 = a missed half), the shortest interrupt (us), parts shed since the load, 'ovl' = on the new firmware the guard's mean interrupt time (us), on the old one the overload mute, and peak_us the longest interrupt (page 127). survey: tools/rig_cpu_survey.py on a directory of the patches, --hold 4, three runs.

old_guard.firmware: CI run 41178937616 (88bcf0c0): the guard of main (two halves in a row over 85 %) plus DIAG page 119

new_guard.firmware: CI run 41185330606 (dc7129f4): a mean over 90 % or a second late half within 2 s
